name: Home Media: Plex, Seerr, Sonarr, Radarr, Prowlarr
tagline: Stream your library, request shows and movies, and keep them organised
notes: The first person to open Plex or Seerr becomes its owner, so open both yourself right after install. To link Plex to your account, set PLEX_CLAIM (from plex.tv/claim, valid 4 minutes) in an env set before the first deploy. Then: Seerr uses sonarr:8989 and radarr:7878 with their API keys; Prowlarr uses http://sonarr:8989 and http://radarr:7878; Plex libraries are /movies and /tv.
